title: Typing event handlers you pull out of JSX

slides.say: Inline handlers are typed for free. Move the handler into its own function, and you need to name the event type.
Inline, TypeScript already knows e is a change event on an input. No annotation needed.
Extracted, type it yourself: React dot Change Event, of HTML input element.

slides.text: Not sure of the type? Hover the prop in your editor. Fallback: React.SyntheticEvent.
slides.say: Not sure which one? Hover the on change prop in your editor and it tells you. For rare events, React dot Synthetic Event is the base type.
